description: This Dart source file defines the FirstScreen widget for a Flutter app, which serves as the initial screen prompting users to grant location and phone permissions before proceeding to the second screen. The widget builds a UI with icons, texts, and a button that initiates permission requests and updates shared preferences.

classes.name: FirstScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the initial onboarding screen asking for user permissions.

classes.name: _FirstScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and behavior of FirstScreen, including permission requests and navigation.

methods.name: _buildPermissionItem
methods.description: Builds UI row for each permission explanation, including icon and description text.

methods.name: _handleAllowPermissions
methods.description: Handles the tap on the 'Allow Permissions' button; requests permissions, saves preferences, and navigates to the next screen.

methods.name: _requestPermissionsAndNavigate
methods.description: Requests location permission, updates shared preferences, and navigates to SecondScreen.
